about: The year-round shelter list for Town · Alerts · Shelters, from the city's Housing and Shelter resource page and the state's emergency-housing page (alerts-sources.json: btv-housing-shelter, vt-dcf-adverse-weather, vt-211). Hand-kept; re-read yearly. Warming and cooling openings during cold snaps are checked by hand and are not in this file.

places.name: COTS Waystation
places.what: Year-round overnight shelter for adults; COTS answers 24/7

places.name: COTS Winter Warming Station
places.what: Open in the winter season, roughly January to May; dates are announced each year

places.name: State emergency housing (adverse weather)
places.what: On nights the state declares adverse weather, motel vouchers open through the Department for Children and Families

places.name: Vermont 2-1-1
places.what: Call 2-1-1 for tonight's open beds and the state's adverse-weather nights
